promise: Pass comprehensive health care reform legislation in 2009
description: In a joint session address Obama told Congress reform 'must happen this year.' The Affordable Care Act was not signed until March 23, 2010, several months after the promised timeline.
evidence: Reform did ultimately pass, fulfilling the substance of the promise

promise: A legally binding post-Kyoto climate agreement to be concluded at COP15 in Copenhagen by the end of 2009.
description: The Bali Roadmap set COP15 as the deadline for a post-2012 agreement. COP15 ended without a binding treaty - only the non-binding Copenhagen Accord was 'taken note of'. A binding successor came only with the Paris Agreement in December 2015, six years late.
evidence: COP15 (Dec 2009) produced no legally binding instrument; the Copenhagen Accord was a 2-page political deal 'taken note of' by the COP
Binding post-Kyoto regime only adopted at Paris, 12 December 2015
